reasons: Datadog plots the raw avg of postgresql.index_scans with no rate or as_rate, so the value is the cumulative scan count. The candidate wraps the monotonic OTel sum in rate(), which yields scans per second. That is a different quantity and unit.
Datadog aggregates with avg across series, while the candidate uses sum. These differ whenever several series share an index.

The $db (prefix db) and $host (prefix host) template variables should become matchers on the dataset labels (postgresql_database_name, host_name). The candidate drops them, so the series set does not match the request. $scope has no prefix and is correctly dropped.

The grouping label postgresql_index_name is not in the observed dataset labels; the dataset is authoritative for label names, so the grouping label needs verification against the dataset before this can translate.
Outcome 'translated' is acceptable because no Datadog function is used, but the PromQL is not an exact translation.
